- Summary: Manufactured by Guangzhou Leimai Machinery (LEIMAI · www.leimaimfg.com), the LM-ODF500 series (scaling modularly from LM-ODF120 Lab R&D and LM-ODF340-4M Pilot to LM-ODF500-10M cGMP Mass Production) documents the complete ODF / Oral Thin Film process from vacuum polymer-matrix slurry preparation (-0.095 MPa) through 0.01 mm (±2 μm, Cpk >= 1.67) servo slot-die/knife multilayer coating, tension-controlled web guidance, 60–65°C controlled-atmosphere dehumidified multi-zone drying (40% energy saving), inline CCD camera & laser thickness inspection, and JULONG US-400S ultrasonic multi-lane slitting/rewinding at 10,560 strips/hour.
- Application: Pharmaceutical oral thin films (OTF/ODF), nutraceutical strips (melatonin, vitamin B12/D3, probiotics, caffeine, herbal/hangover strips), nicotine strips, breath freshening strips, and pet oral dissolving medication/supplement films.

  - Production Output (LM-ODF500): 10,560 strips/hour (50 cm coating width, 22×32 mm strips)
  - Servo Coating Accuracy: 0.01 mm (10 μm), ±2 μm tolerance (Cpk ≥ 1.67, USP <905> RSD ≤ 1.5%)
  - Controlled-Atmosphere Drying: 60–65°C dehumidified multi-zone circulation (40% energy saving)
  - Web Guidance & Inspection: Tension control + JULONG US-400S ultrasonic sensor (±0.1 mm) + CCD vision
  - Complete Line Integration: Vacuum defoaming → LM-ODF500 coating/slitting → LM-ODF260 pouching → CXZ-100 cartoner
